description: Order-to-cash lifecycle backbone as event-driven microservices (NestJS 11 + Nuxt 4 + MySQL 8 + MongoDB + Kafka + NATS). Assessment #7 of the order-to-cash trilogy.

rules.state_machine: pending -> [spec_author] -> spec_ready -> HUMAN APPROVES -> in_progress -> [implementer] -> in_review -> [reviewer] -> done | blocked

features.name: orders_idempotent_replay
features.title: orders.create requestId idempotent replay (asyncapi.yaml OrdersCreateRequestPayload.requestId)
acceptance: a repeated orders.create request carrying the same requestId returns the ORIGINAL order (same orderId/orderReference/money fields), not a second placement
concurrent duplicate requests for the same requestId never place two orders
requestId remains optional: omitting it places a normal, non-deduplicated order
features.notes: Opened by review_orders_acceptance.md's D3. asyncapi.yaml's OrdersCreateRequestPayload.requestId description is normative ("A repeat with the same value returns the original order instead of placing a second one") but orders_acceptance (feature 15) does not implement it — requestId is accepted, validated, and used only to seed causationId (place-order.handler.ts). Needs a persisted request_id column/lookup and a decision on the race between two concurrent first-time requests with the same key; deliberately not folded into feature 15's defect-fix pass because it is schema-affecting, not a local bug fix.
